title: v2.1.163 - Enterprise Version Management & Enhanced Plugin Controls
description: Added version management controls for enterprise deployments, enhanced plugin management with /plugin list command supporting filters, improved /btw with clipboard copy shortcut, and enhanced hooks capabilities.

title: v2.1.162 - Enhanced Agent CLI & Tool Specifications
description: Enhanced claude agents --json with waitingFor field showing session blockers, improved tool specification for Grep/Glob on native builds, added /effort persistence confirmation, and enhanced slash command autocomplete behavior.

title: v2.1.161 - OpenTelemetry Integration & Enhanced MCP Management
description: OpenTelemetry integration with custom label support via OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES, improved claude agents UI with progress indicators, enhanced /mcp connector management with unused connector collapsing, and improved parallel tool call error handling.

title: v2.1.160 - Safety Prompts for Config File Writes
description: Added safety prompts before writing to shell startup files and git config, enhanced acceptEdits mode to prompt before build-tool config writes, improved Edit tool behavior after grep operations.

title: v2.1.158 - Auto Mode Support for Multiple Platforms
description: Extended Auto mode support to Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry platforms for Opus 4.7 and 4.8 models via CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AUTO_MODE=1 environment variable.

title: v2.1.157 - Automatic Plugin Loading & Enhanced Agent Commands
description: Automatic plugin loading from .claude/skills directories, added claude plugin init scaffolding command, enhanced plugin autocomplete, improved claude agents with settings.json support, and enhanced EnterWorktree switching capabilities.

title: v2.1.156 - Critical Opus 4.8 Thinking Block Fix
description: Fixed critical issue with Opus 4.8 where thinking blocks were being modified, causing API errors.

title: v2.1.154 - Opus 4.8 & Dynamic Workflows Launch
description: Introduced Opus 4.8 with high-effort default (/effort xhigh), launched dynamic workflows orchestrating tens to hundreds of background agents, reduced Fast mode cost to 2x standard rate for 2.5x speed, and made lean system prompt the default.

title: v2.1.153 - Enhanced Plugin Sources & Diagnostics
description: Added skipLfs option for GitHub/git plugin sources, added npm global install auto-update notice with /doctor diagnostics, enhanced status line commands with terminal size environment variables, improved claude agents autocomplete.

title: v2.1.152 - Enhanced Code Review with Auto-Fix
description: Enhanced /code-review --fix to apply findings and renamed /simplify to /code-review, added disallowed-tools frontmatter for skills/slash commands, added /reload-skills command, enhanced SessionStart hooks with reloadSkills capability.

title: v2.1.149 - Enhanced Usage Analytics & Enterprise Settings
description: Enhanced /usage with per-category breakdown (skills, subagents, plugins, MCP servers), improved /diff detail view with keyboard scrolling, added GFM task list checkbox rendering, added enterprise allowAllClaudeAiMcps managed setting.

title: v2.1.148 - Bash Tool Exit Code Fix
description: Fixed Bash tool returning exit code 127 on every command for some users (regression from v2.1.147).

title: v2.1.147 - Pinned Background Sessions & Code Review Renaming
description: Enhanced pinned background sessions (Ctrl+T) with persistent idle behavior, renamed /simplify to /code-review with enhanced correctness bug reporting, improved auto-updater with retry logic and better error messages.
